description:
crates/outram-park-fork-dwsim-libs/src/columns/mod.rs carries a 'Quick start' example that is `no_run`, so it compiles but has never been executed. Running it verbatim fails: methane/ethane, 10 stages at 101325 Pa / 200 K, reflux_ratio(2.0) + product_molar_flow(0.5) with PengRobinson gives ColumnError::NotConverged { iterations: 100, error: 2.15e-4 } from the default Wang-Henke solver.

A benzene/toluene case on the same shape converges fine (8 stages, Ideal package, feed on stage 4: Wang-Henke 16 iterations to 6.9e-7; Naphtali-Sandholm 1 iteration; top 355.4 K, bottom 376.2 K, x_benzene 0.846 -> 0.154), so the API in the example is right and only the numbers are bad.

Either retune the example to a converging case or say plainly that it is illustrative and will not converge. As written it is a trap: the first thing a reader copies fails, and the failure looks like a solver bug rather than a badly-posed column.

Found while checking how to run the column code from the Python bindings.
title: columns: the module-doc quick start does not converge as written

design:
Child of the multi-thermo flowsheet epic (bn op-186o).


Inspect how upstream DWSIM handles package assignment and stream transitions.

Determine: whether packages are global or per-unit/per-stream; how
`MaterialStream` associates with a package; how different packages coexist in
one flowsheet; whether DWSIM already has equivalent transition semantics; how
**enthalpy references** are handled; how electrolyte/non-electrolyte boundaries
are handled.

**Port good semantics; do not reproduce .NET object-ownership patterns.** This
fork should improve the architecture while preserving validated thermodynamic
algorithms.

Note the port has already diverged deliberately on exactly this point (the
dropped back-pointer), so the question is not "what does DWSIM do" but "what
did DWSIM's approach buy, and do we need any of it".


## Constraints

Mature-crate refactor: preserve public constructors, deprecate rather than remove, regression tests before semantic changes. Do not implement AGR/Claus/the refinery here. `develop` only, no push to `main`.
title: MultiThermo: Audit upstream DWSIM property-package semantics

description:
The multicomponent flash in crates/outram-park-fork-dwsim-libs/src/thermo/ is real, tested and unused. Wiring it into tampines is a wiring job, not a solver-writing job -- but the wiring job is LARGER than first reported (see the correction below).

WHAT EXISTS (verified 2026-08-07):
- src/thermo/ = 26,518 lines across 35 .rs files, 223 #[test].
- src/thermo/flash.rs:194 pub fn rachford_rice_g   (cites DWSIM NestedLoops.vb line 344/553)
- src/thermo/flash.rs:206 pub fn rachford_rice_dg  (cites NestedLoops.vb line 554)
- src/thermo/flash.rs:424 pub fn nested_loops_flash<F>  -- real outer K-value iteration with convergence + error handling
- src/thermo/flash_vlle.rs:478 pub fn flash_pt_vlle -- real 3-phase VLLE with stability test, calls nested_loops_flash
- Tests: flash.rs 6 (:502, :533, :558, :581, :604, :639); flash_vlle.rs 4 (:624, :658, :690, :720).

ZERO callers of the flash routines from tampines -- and zero from anywhere in the workspace outside the dwsim crate itself.

CORRECTION to the original claim (do not repeat the "~17 call sites, pump/turbine/pipe already wired" figure -- it was a grep artifact; 13 of the 17 were doc comments):
crates/tampines/Cargo.toml:37 does declare the dependency, but tampines has only 4 `use` statements importing TYPES, and invokes exactly TWO dwsim functions in total:
  - valve.rs:35   self.opening_characteristic.kv_at_opening(...)
  - pipe.rs:88    PipeFlowCorrelation::default()
Every component evaluation method is an unwired stub returning TampinesError::NotYetImplemented:
  - pump.rs:35-38 (its own doc at :30-34 says "the underlying algebra already exists and works ... this wrapper's job ... is not yet wired up")
  - valve.rs:51 (mass_flow), heat_exchanger.rs:45, turbine.rs:40
  - turbine.rs does not even `use` dwsim; it only names it in doc links.

So the work is: finish the ~15 NotYetImplemented component wrappers over dwsim-libs, then add a PT/VLLE flash entry point for tampines' fluid state. Add a test that actually calls the flash through tampines -- today nothing does.
title: tampines: wire the tested dwsim flash + finish the NotYetImplemented component wrappers
